tagline.en: Monthly pension of Rs. 2016/- for eligible categories (Old Age, Widow, Weavers, Toddy Tappers, HIV-AIDS, Beedi Workers, Single Women, Filaria Patients) and Rs. 3016/- for Disabled persons under Aasara Scheme.

source.quote: GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA ABSTRACT Social Security Pensions - Aasara Pensions - Social Safety Net Strategy - Enhancement of financial assistance under Aasara Scheme for the persons who are Old & infirm, Widows, Differently Abled, Weavers, Toddy Tappers, HIV-AIDS patients, Beedi Workers, Single Women and Filaria Patients - Orders - Issued.

summary.en: Monthly pension of Rs. 2016/- for eligible categories (Old Age, Widow, Weavers, Toddy Tappers, HIV-AIDS, Beedi Workers, Single Women, Filaria Patients) and Rs. 3016/- for Disabled persons under Aasara Scheme.

source.quote: Enhanced monthly Pension under Aasara Scheme w.e.f. June, 2019 payable in July, 2019 (Rs.): 2016/-

summary.en: Apply through the District Collectors, DRDOs, MPDOs, or Municipal Commissioners in the State as per the operational guidelines of the Aasara Scheme.

source.quote: The District Collectors of all Districts. The DRDOs, DRDA/ Project Directors, ITDA. All Municipal Commissioners. All MPDOs in the State.
